notes: Algorithm measured on AE 2026 8 bpc: shadow alpha = Opacity/255 * blur(layer alpha shifted by (trunc(d*sin th), trunc(-d*cos th))) (offset truncated toward zero to whole pixels, th = Direction from up, clockwise); blur = 3 successive box blurs, separable, fractional radius r = 0.1846*Softness (r = n+f: taps -n..n weight 1, +-(n+1) weight f; Softness 30 fits exactly with r in [5.534, 5.542]); shadow colour = Shadow Color rgb (its alpha ignored); output = original + shadow*(1 - original alpha), or the shadow alone when Shadow Only = 1. Pass 0 = horizontal blur stored as 16-bit packed in R,G (Rive keeps intermediate passes in RGBA8), pass 1 = vertical blur + tint + composite with origTex. Residual <= 1-2 levels comes from AE's integer arithmetic (some half-levels rounded down). Not reproduced: AE 7 Compositing Options (effect opacity / effect masks). Above 255 taps per axis (Softness > ~220 px) the taps are strided (approximation, still smooth). The shadow spills outside the layer in AE: in Rive give the node a `pad` >= |offset| + 3*(r+1) to see it.
